summary: Jushi Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a proposed redomicile (continuance) from British Columbia, Canada to Nevada, USA. No financial terms, premium, or price per share were disclosed. The board will seek shareholder approval via a proxy statement to be filed on Schedule 14A. The process involves regulatory filings with the SEC and SEDAR+. No advisors or break fees were named. This is a corporate re-domestication, not a transactional special situation. Watch for shareholder meeting dates and any dissident activity around the vote.
